description: This is a C# source file containing a benchmarking class for comparing serialization performance of a struct type using various serialization libraries and methods, including Orleans, Utf8Json, System.Text.Json, MessagePack, Protobuf, Hyperion, ZeroFormatter, Newtonsoft.Json, and SpanJson.

classes.name: StructSerializeBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class that measures and compares the serialization performance of a struct using multiple serialization libraries and methods.

methods.name: Orleans
methods.description: Serializes the input struct with Orleans serializer and returns the length of serialized data.

methods.name: Utf8Json
methods.description: Serializes the input struct using Utf8Json and returns the length of the output.

methods.name: SystemTextJson
methods.description: Serializes the input struct using System.Text.Json and returns the length.

methods.name: MessagePackCSharp
methods.description: Serializes the input struct using MessagePack and returns the length of the serialized byte array.

methods.name: ProtobufNet
methods.description: Serializes the input struct using Protobuf-net and returns the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: Hyperion
methods.description: Serializes the input struct using Hyperion serializer and returns the length of the output.

methods.name: ZeroFormatter
methods.description: Serializes the input struct using ZeroFormatter (commented out in the code).

methods.name: NewtonsoftJson
methods.description: Serializes the input struct to JSON string with Newtonsoft.Json and returns the byte length.

methods.name: SpanJsonUtf8
methods.description: Serializes the input struct using SpanJson's Utf8 serializer and returns its length.
